settings.heading: Description
settings.content:
The Lexington Velvet Accent Chair is a stunning piece that combines modern elegance with bold, edgy details. Perfect for a contemporary living room or office, this chair features luxurious materials and a minimalist silhouette that stands out in any space. The gently curved backrest is designed for both comfort and style, providing ample support while adding a sophisticated look.

Seat Cushion: The seat cushion is generously padded with high-density foam, ensuring maximum comfort and maintaining its shape over time.

Legs: The chair stands on four slender, tapered legs that are slightly splayed for stability. The polished chrome finish on the legs adds a modern, industrial edge to the design.

settings.heading: Materials + Care
settings.content: Premium velvet in a rich emerald green, offering a sumptuous texture that is both soft to the touch and visually striking. Sturdy stainless steel frame with a polished chrome finish, providing a sleek, reflective surface that contrasts beautifully with the plush velvet. The Lexington Velvet Accent Chair is available in several rich colors, including deep sapphire blue, charcoal gray, and classic black, each paired with the chrome frame for a striking contrast.

settings.heading: Sleek design with an edge
settings.description: Sleek design with an edge in furniture typically involves a combination of minimalist aesthetics with bold, striking elements.

settings.heading: Armrests
settings.description: The armrests are seamlessly integrated into the frame, featuring a smooth, continuous line that accentuates the chair's sleek profile.

settings.heading: Sleek Silhouette
settings.description: Features clean, minimalist lines that create a modern and sophisticated look. This design choice emphasizes simplicity while maintaining a striking presence.

settings.heading: Cushion Fillings
settings.description: Options include high-density foam for firm support, memory foam for personalized comfort, or down fillings for a plush, luxurious feel.

settings.heading: Ergonomic Design
settings.description: Features that include supportive backrests and well-padded seats to ensure maximum comfort. Ergonomic designs are tailored to fit the natural curves of the body, enhancing relaxation.
